matches.rationale: The ground truth is a corrupted expression/definition of the operation ⊙_t, whose detectable consequence is that results relying on it no longer compute correctly. Findings 1 and 2 quote the paper's definition of c ⊙_{l,k} d and show, with machine-checked arithmetic, that it is inconsistent with the operation's use in the downstream equations (a+b = 2(cd+c+d), x+P(y−x) = z+w+zw), i.e. the sign/parameter relation in the operation's expression is wrong. Per R2/R3, blaming the downstream instantiation rather than the definition does not break the match.
